description: This file defines the CallbackSerializer type, which manages scheduling and executing callbacks in a thread-safe FIFO manner, with support for context cancellation.

classes.name: CallbackSerializer
classes.description: A struct that manages scheduling and executing callbacks with FIFO order, supporting concurrent access and context cancellation.

methods.name: NewCallbackSerializer
methods.description: Creates a new CallbackSerializer instance and starts its run loop.

methods.name: TrySchedule
methods.description: Attempts to schedule a callback for execution; if the context was canceled before scheduling, it does not add the callback.

methods.name: ScheduleOr
methods.description: Schedules a callback or executes an onFailure function if scheduling fails due to context cancellation.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Returns a channel that is closed when all callbacks have been executed and the serializer is shut down.
